notes.title: Polishing and bug fixing
notes.content:
Hello everyone, friends! Pirozhok Studio is in touch. Today's patch has brought some new mechanics and significant improvements of the existing ones. Let's take a closer look!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/72e984406ba63c21fe62e1b354744d28fe0f37b6.png[/img]

[h1]New content.[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New threat.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/a19cd111bb30a14e823f023819598c94151de285.gif[/img]

Rebuilding another area undreground, a player may run into [b]cobolds[/b], searching for ore and gems. After beating the cobolds, a player will be able to claim their treasures.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/d467f1b2bdf1bd909447dc760b2235e548261ce4.png[/img]

[*] [b]Heroes rework.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/39aa5a9a7df079d069fd78efdfd4a2753201a28d.jpg[/img]

Heroes levelling up was reworked. The level cap was increased to [b]12[/b], and every ability has 3 grades, affecting their effectiveness - spell damage, duration, cooldown, etc. 
Besides, after reaching a new level, heroes not get extra damage and health points.
For example, on the first level of [i]"Death call"[/i] spell the Death Knight summons one lesser skeleton, on the second - one skeleton warrior, and two skeleton warriors on the third.

[*] [b]Resource carrying.[/b]
This mechanics was also reworked. If a minion who carries resources changes his occupation, he drops a bag with the resources on the ground. The bag can be carried to the town hall by any free minion. Moreover, a new profession - carrier - was introduced. Carriers will pick bags and flay dead animals. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/2ccab43af4b62e197c1a052b023ff890c5f3b2c0.gif[/img]

[*] [b]End of the game.[/b]
When a player goes through all chalengess, offered to him, he'll have a choice, either to leave, or to keep playing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/d7777e0164c61a2653c9671cb33a4392ff408b1f.png[/img]

[h1]Minor changes.[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now you can ask the ambassador to postpone the payment of tribute. After two days, he will request resources again, and there won't be such an option.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/ae898054dbeea76eb0581cb821daaeb15a5db157.jpg[/img]

[*] The size of the map has been increased.
[*] Now there is a possibility to cut down a particular tree. Minions don't carry the wood to the town hall, a bag with resources apears next to the logging site.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/ab5c62291316fa38a83513f29cdb960b9826ba9e.png[/img]

[*] Behaviour modes were added to heroes.
[*] Heroes levels don't reset after death anymore.
[*] [b]Notification system[/b] was reworked.
[*] Minions [b]skills panel[/b] was reworked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/cbc37d810aaf0a010191c0139fadd9ba309a91a9.png[/img]

[*] Heroes spell descriptions were rewritten.
[*] Rations menu was reworked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/ecc3f377d9b5dd0893b156d5c80d51df311903f0.png[/img]

[*] The ration menu and sacrifice menu indicate the current amount of food and the current god's grace.
[*] The health bars of all units were aligned.
[*] Control of a minion isn't removed after assigning him to job.
[*] Minions automatically rebuild beams in the mine in the absence of resources in the accessible zone. After the construction of the beam minions continue their previous work.
[*] Research points are given after the final construction of the town hall.
[*] The term for hiring mercenaries, a priest and a jester can be extended to an indefinite number of days for money.
[*] Minions breed automatically from time to time.
[*] The northern citizens do not attack player units first.
[*] Now, when taking damage from disease and cold, minions cough.
[*] The spawn rate of animals has been reduced.
[*] In winter, the subjects of the God of sun do not take damage from cold and move twice as fast as others.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes.[/h1]
The following bugs were fixed in this patch:
[list]
[*] Units attack nearby enemy, even if you tell them to attack a different target.
[*] Nord towers don't switch to the nearest target, while the first spotted one is in sight.
[*] Hunters get stuck on the spot.
[*] NPC workers get stuck on the spot.
[*] Mage projectiles get stuck in the air.
[*] Elves do not leave at the end of the Winter Solstice.
[*] Villagers are running around on the spot after being kileedt.
[*] Villagers do not receive damage from the "Killing touch" spell.
[*] Fire elementals do not receive damage from the "Killing touch" spell.
[*] Minion's disease icon appears to be too small sometimes.
[*] Transparent buildings interface.
[*] Incorrect display of the hero’s experience scale.
[*] Incorrect display of text in the workshop.
[*] Incorrect display of text in the dialogues of the hero.
[*] Lack of text in the merchant's dialog window.
[*] Bowmen at the gates trying to shoot themselves.
[*] Mages get stuck on the spot if the distance to the attacked target is too little.
[*] Hiring soldiers and mages causes lags and freezes.
[*] The cursor disappears from time to time.
[*] Minions appear in multiple slots on the people menu (T).
[/list]

That's all for now, folks! Leave your comments, share your opinion, as it helps me to improve the game!

notes.title: Random events, world generation, personal traits
notes.content:
Good day everyone! Pirozhok Studio is in touch.
Today's patch affects the late game. Many players told us there was nothing left to do after beating the nords and the necromancer. Well, the time has come to change it.

[h1][b][u]Random events.[/u][/b][/h1]

I've done a great work on new random events, which may happen with your settlement in the late game.

[list]
[*] First event that I proudly present to you is [b]the undead scourge[/b]. 

[b]All the world[/b] plunges into chaos and destruction during the event:

[list]

[*] [b]Weather.[/b] The sun is shrouded by the plague fumes that rise from the ground, and at night the bloodmoon shines:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/323981e56da1b49d402071a55e34fc73aad35451.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/6858cf0fdaa78e607af9f31e4703a4246aa4659b.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Invasion of the undead[/b]. Numerous [b]graves full of undead[/b] ready to massacre everyone alive appear all over the world. In this situation living beings unite in attempt to save their lives. The sun does not burn the undead armies down during the day, making it even more difficult to fight them off.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1wn4oWoShftuv3gicT/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Refugees[/b]. Catastrophe like that will undoubly cause people from other settlements flee to cover behind the walls of your settlement. The player will have to choose either to let them stay or to drive them off (you don't need more eaters, do you?). Some of them will obediently go away, but others might try to take what's theirs by force.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/ab1f2a013b9ca0c59fe6c3cc224200d174714b77.png[/img]

[*] [b]Fallen peasants and soldiers[/b] will turn into undead, slaughtering their former brothers-in-arms, whatever the matter of death is. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/tsSrYwSds3EQxP1WY0/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] The event ends in a few days but might happen again in the span of the next 15 days.
[/list]

[*] The second event is the [b]peasant uprising[/b]. Peasants that are displeased with your rule might start an uprising. You can distinguish them from the loyal ones by the masks and special icons above their heads.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/95b458e3cdbb8ce6c400ce1c1a3391083faa9584.png[/img]

[*] The third event is [b]lycanthropy[/b]. Some of your subjects get sick with a strange disease. It might lead to irreversible consequences if you don't take care of them...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/affa4bf10c8c49564001fd6c42c2456baac28d00.gif[/img]

[*] Besides, many small random events were added, like [b]crop diseases[/b] or [b]hop weevil[/b] (Hi, Stronghold!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/e72cb5cd3d4f0aaf26162823b617ac2c4d042931.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]World map.[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] I've seriously reworked world generation in this patch. Now the world is created randomly from one of pre-packaged presets and gets filled with random ruins, towns and bandit camps. Such a way of world generation was chosen, as it allows to combine replayability with the advantages of manual level design.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/62e04f2681e4bf25c5b895c9f4496d225b752a64.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/8b2d2d39d3077622e5ac20620f0a7f1e556c76d8.png[/img]

[i]A nothern town may now spawn to the left of the player's settlement[/i]

[*] A serious work on [b]the minimap[/b] was done. 
Now it shows the current situation on the global map. Besides, the fog of war affects it too.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/7275e169033b2fdf112c327ea59a1726a63c2493.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]New personal traits.[/u][/b][/h1]

Player's subjects now have 6 new traits:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/96d745ea799c071b796e0448104691be58420e47.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Quick[/b] - this minion moves 10% faster than others.
[*] [b]Hesitant[/b] - this minion moves 10% slower than others.
[*] [b]Drunkard[/b] - this minion's mood can be increased only with booze.
[*] [b]Holy[/b] - this minion doesn't drink beer. At all.
[*] [b]Tireless[/b] - this minion's energy decreases twice slower.
[*] [b]Sleepyhead[/b] - this minion's energy decreases twice faster.
[/list]

[h1][b][u]Miscellaneous.[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]

[*] The "game over" window was also updated. There will be at least three types of it depending on the player's success during his reign and the end of it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/76036e031674535f6a46f55ead10561fccacc777.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/48f40519b45391ad139b2726182395df95200579.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/ef5be69c0aaa4535356d8e88d400ce1035c6568e.png[/img]

[*] Leather armor was also redrawn. The old armor looked bad and didn't fit. The new armor looks like that:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/23a3cb96d40feb88f89a217cead947b8539c16da.gif[/img]

[i]This peasant lost his head over himself[/i]

[*] New northern raiders have arrived!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/496ffc307d4bf33b69c3974dcf56be0b299a3e2f.png[/img]

[*] Many dialogues and descriptions were rewritten. Okri and Maxold had sunk into the abyss, meet Berthold the craftsman and Godric the fletcher instead:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/deb8f2a98a890c000ec9e55814dd9775042a133e.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/524249fe8db171a9d03aad629ffa6bd76c67951e.png[/img]

[*] New sounds were added to the game - 4 for each type of weapon and armor!
[*] I'm also proud to introduce you to the new nordern raiders theme. This theme was heavily inspired with the northern folklore and culture. Vocal and drums are widely used in the Scandinavian music, so we used them in this soundtrack to make it sound authentic. Hope you'll like it:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TyK3kV-_35g

[/list]

[h1][b][u]Bug fixes.[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Firing units from farms doesn't cause problems anymore
[*] Minions don't get stuck at the hospital anymore
[*] Minions don't get stuck after having a bath
[*] Several sprites were shown incorrect at the necromancer's hideout
[*] Northern citizens used to behavy incorrect after their defeat
[/list]

That's all for now, folks! Leave your comments and criticism. You help the game to get better! 

Yours, 
Life is Hard dev :eitolstii:

-----------------------------
Some useful links:

[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/pirozhok
[b]Twitter: [/b]https://twitter.com/pirozhokstudio
[b]VK: [/b]https://vk.com/pekaclub

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/51b9c59d2197922ecafd6ce9a4f2d5fd12d3d816.png[/img]

notes.title: New world map, shields and weapons
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Pirozhok Studio is here. I'm glad to announce new mechanics for today's update. There are so many of them that I could hardly find where to start.

[h1][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]First of all, world map was changed.[/b] Eastern Kingdom, Islands and naga were removed from the game. World map looks like that now:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/2b8b0867db7f09c97df06a78e7508a6be6ebd4cf.png[/img]

Nord location's appearance was also changed - now it's a rocky sea shore:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/afe97e09245ba7d69afd4255f21283fe77635233.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/5ce0bb60cae916f29e017fbf39e50c6209d220df.png[/img]

[*] [b]Different difficulty levels were finally implemented.[/b] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/47843997b96fc8b7c810429bde831f78c3f55b13.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Your subjects have learned to construct two new buildings![/b] 

[I]A school[/i] will help your minions to improve their skills in different professions. You'll need a minion with a "Teacher" trait or a master in one of professions to make it work:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/df89060677ca0c211322a7270c5495b2e19f7c26.jpg[/img]

[i]A market[/i] attracts trading caravans from other towns, bringing [b]money[/b] to the settlement:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/cad9e5cf2338b1274c1faafbddf32a8a691cb431.png[/img]

[*] [b]Meat the mages![/b] You can train mages in a wizard tower. Mages can wear robes and leather armor and use wands as weapons. Low armor is compensated with high damage and high effectiveness against heavy armored units.

[I]Mage without a wand:[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/40e20cfc4c6466081960819f016187ef134a39e5.gif[/img]

[I]Mage with a fire wand:[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/5000e49d47a2c212f9e8d47be9ded932dc1e40ab.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Shields were implemented.[/b] Soldiers can use one of three shield types -a round shields, kite shields and tower shields. Every one of them has advantages and disadvantages. Shields can be crafted in the workshop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/932510d03afd44322678ce66f48dbde8ca678933.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Mercenaries were redesigned.[/b] Now you'll be able to hire those cutthroats instead of five similar units. Every one of them has their one weapon and armor types:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/39189c45dc743fc4f086df1d83183cd4868e095a.jpg[/img]

[I]Before:[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/e004d47350963c6851871975e31a19417bae8385.gif[/img]

[I]After:[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/d40f56cce35cf044d40a01d7d582fe26e52cea85.gif[/img]

[*] [b]You'll be able to find treasure in the mine.[/b] Or ruins of an ancient settlements. Explore carefully!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/9541532919261b14f5b104134f1154d2e4bcac0c.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Two new weapons were added.[/b] Military picks effectively puncture heavy armor, and two-handed axes deal terrible damage to unarmored units:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/7dd97a160a4b1140b0d169bd0aab7ae8ab982331.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/6ec278bbff85bdfb3958974126e5c4c0ce078f4b.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Two new effects were added.[/b] Some weapon types provoke bleeding, dealing periodic damage. Weapons of the undead might provoke poisoning, making your units miss with a 40% chance.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/86b777d0727fcff5a9addf7f9a0e714a2af82219.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New traits were added:[/b]

1) [i]Undead slayer [/i]- your unit deals 25% more damage to the undead
2) [i]Nords slayer [/i]- your unit deals 25% more damage to the nords
3) [i]Fear of undead[/i] - your unit deals 25% less damage to the undead
4) [i]Fear of nords [/i]- your unit deals 25% less damage to the nords

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/8d9723a2b1c1d426ea86a0e9e63a7cb197b0cec0.jpg[/img]

[/list]

[h1][b][u]Control changes:[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] [b] Hero and soldiers[/b] can descend into the mine now.

[img]https://psv4.userapi.com/c848032/u152454277/docs/d7/c27fcb05c8b1/HeroMine.gif?extra=L3H79boGMZYXLuCXJFVbPpjjoJcuKedEywDQq0EIEw5mOYgeelSK5zmU68ZkqrS13HZnQTBc_5mlA9FZ7s9LTybO_hod0Q5q5BMNc6Upt78yUw0MqReW9T2eJ8hgQzmzrEOKXWo0KsppOYRtZrU3AyU[/img]

[*] [b] Workshop interface[/b] was noticeably changed. Items were divided into three types - "weapons", "armor" and "miscellaneous":

[img]https://psv4.userapi.com/c848036/u152454277/docs/d18/e7807b17d727/Blacksmith.gif?extra=-X3oQFti2TGP_AIgZONuqD8T1GFe5ja07DGW-b0ibpJ-tm1lYcc9p5EtYIt_gElG9l-dE416JTNFl6U8ctCfnNZEd2-Cyl-dxtQFA4juzCJVTbLbB09cWufC3vtkXPZrpqmnjRy4AvzRwXE7Xili76c[/img]

[*] [b] Soldiers Control panel[/b] was also changed - now they have personal traits:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/92edb09f852304f04d30e64638f82d9b51835740.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Behaviour mode[/b] or [b]attack move[/b] for all chosen units were implemented.

[*] Pressing [b]Shift[/b] you'll move to a free minion now.
[*] Pressing [b]Tab[/b] one chooses hero, pressing it twice will move the camera to him.
[/list]

[h1][b][u]Graphic changes:[/u][/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Banners[/b] were redesigned:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/003cde903772f1a9b6376afe94ab0696db452a12.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Loading screens[/b] were redesigned:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/9e694763c2026533dd049a5ec4e4685e9021f8d5.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Helmets[/b] were redesigned too. Ancient helmets might be dropped from the skeletons. They are slightly better that the leather ones, but are quite bulky to use, slowing your minions down:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/6a581d671d52a097339820f1e6320f8da19fbb4c.png[/img]

[*] [b]Names and appearance[/b] of the minions were redesigned:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/b98ee40a85af81f35fcdb31052a685b627abd68e.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Iron[/b] armor and weapons were redesigned too.
[/list]

[h1][b][u]Bug fixes:[/u][/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Incorrect hero behaviour in battles
[*] Impossibility to hire minions to farms using the control menu (T)
[*] Incorrect soldiers and mercenaries behaviour near hunting minions
[*] Incorrect rations pictures after loading the game

[*] Incorrect ore spawn in the mine
[*] Incorrect bears behaviour
[*] Incorrect fence length on the background

[*] Ore and stone amount that is gained from villages was slightly decreased
[*] Minions quit their job after bathing
[*] Minions bug out after hiring them into the mine using control panel
[*] Ammunition choice bugs out using control panel 
[*] Goblin and dwarf traders bug out
[*] Incorrect expedition wagon behaviour
[*] Heroes ranged attacks bug out
[*] Quests are not loaded
[*] Towers are not loaded
[*] "No soap" icon bugs out
[*] Catapult armor type is not shown
[*] Incorrect skeletons behaviour during the daytime
[*] Incorrect underground skeletons behaviour
[*] Incorrect support beams sprites while building
[*] Buildings overlap
[*] Childrens' heads bug out
[*] "Fighter" and "Puny" bug out
[*] Forest background bugs out
[*] Nords bowmen' armor types bug out
[/list]

That's all for now, folks! I'm planning to implement secondary weapons for arches and random words generation. Share your opinion and don't forget to join our [url=discord.gg/pirozhok]Discord-channel![/url]

notes.title: Announcing new patch & plans for the future
notes.content:
Hello, ladies and fellas!
It's been a long time since I wrote a post on Steam - much was changing in my life, so I had time only to support the project and fix the bugs you found.
However, I'm in charge again, and I'm glad to announce some new features & mechanics for the next patch:

[i]UPD: it's not out yet, this post is just an announce![/i]

[list]
[*][b]First of all, money is finally going to appear in Life is Hard.[/b]
 A player will be able to construct a new building - market - that attracts merchants and caravans from all over the tiny world. They will buy goods from your minions and pay with gold!

[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c847018/v847018210/152120/HeCZnjuRKxU.jpg[/img]
[i]Hiring mercenaries, monks, jesters etc. will require money from now on. No more barter![/i]

[*][b]Secondly, mages will stand by your side.[/b]
 You'll be able to hire new units at the mage's tower. [strike] Seems legit, doesn't it?[/strike] Mages are equipped with light armor & wands. Soldiers will lose ability to use them.

[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c847018/v847018210/152133/lRi6mDD7ojg.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Villages' conquest.
notes.content:
Hello, dear members of our community!
The developers of "Life is Hard" are on line.

It's been almost 3 months since the last documented update, and we think that it's time to shed a light on everything that happens behind the scenes of our production plant.

[h1]About what we have done[/h1]

Yesterday we've pushed the last update before a big work we're going to do (written about it below), which contains significant updates of villages, balance and the final of the game.

We came to agreement that the real world is seemed being alive just because it can exist without any player's interactions. In our game the world requires constant interactions.

It was decided to add some neutral villages, which are located between the player's village and nords' lands.
A real race has now been started between nords and player: to conquer every village.
After a village capture, its inhabitants will fight on the side of a conquerors and periodically send tribute consisted of a small amount of iron.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/e8ee2f53833e3dd6cf2f1dc1975b0d9ec70e6701.jpg[/img]

In addition, we've introduced some random events. So, for example, if minions are sick, they will make a medicine themselves. Moreover, occasional minion can invite their partner of the opposite sex for a hot cup of coffee.

A severe rebalance of nagas has been made. You used to beat naga, now nagas will beat you.

Oh, numerous bugs have been fixed.

[h1]About what we are going to do[/h1]

As we have noted, this update is the final before the big work that we will do over the game.

Due to modest knowledge at the beginning of the game development, the lines of code were repeatedly duplicated, and bugs were fixed with "crutches" (even "crutches for crutches" are presented in the code), and no one could do anything about it. The code was polluted, and some fragments began to resemble cancerous tumors.

Now we want to act radically: completely rewrite the game code.

[b]What does it mean for you?[/b]
We will try to optimize the game and escape it from many childhood diseases, such as memory leaks and long load screens.

[b]What does it mean for us?[/b]
First of all, the redesigned and correctly placed code will allow us to determine and fix bugs much faster. In addition, introductions of new content will be more smoothly than before.

[b]What does it mean for everybody?[/b]
Due to an amount of the current content that must be recreated, the next major update may be released not soon.

notes.title: VERY huge update.
notes.content:
Greetings, community! 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/4b2364c323c49dfebcaa79ebb56d8ab4c0511ebe.gif[/img]

We've done a painstaking work on "Life is Hard" and now we can say with confidence that it was a big step to the game's full release. 
Moreover, the list of changes appeared to be very huge, so we decided to break with tradition and write a changelog. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ 

[b]A small notice for users of 64-bit Windows:[/b] we've recently updated the method of switching between builds, so we strongly recommend to make a full reinstallation (with manual directory clean up) of the game in order to clean up the space on the computer. 

[h1]NEW:[/h1][list] 
[*] The tutorial has been updated. 
[*] Most of the interface has been redrawn in the united style.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/1a1d9dca317f1c472c6c00423e6858c0c656192b.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/8c1d518bc1a9e7926b05a2bede08696887ef435a.jpg[/img]
[*] A wagon's mechanics has been reworked.
After upgrading a town hall to the third level, player receives an ability to send a group of minions (1-4) on the journey. Many different events may happen with the travelers, which will affect the amount of resources and people the wagon will bring back home.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/eea0d5d1fb46abd35d43a10e106e14b66f896a52.jpg[/img]
[*] Now you can group your soldiers. 
When a squad is created, a button appears in the left lower corner. Pressing it once selects members of the group. Pressing it twice moves the camera on the standard-bearer of the squad.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/ce1664a3a62c5d139f09e9679a5c348243ac328f.jpg[/img]
[*] Icons above minions heads can now be pressed. Pressing one cancels current task of the minion. 
[*] Pressing spacebar selects the hero. Double-press moves the camera on him. 
[*] Now the camera smoothly moves to the target instead of teleportation. 
[*] Buildings of nomads and their music have been renewed.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/298c3d0ed6aa9f5ad5e9fdc17e59a232fc070b6f.jpg[/img]
[*] Flora and fauna of different locations were added – camels, jerboas and camel-thorns in the desert, crabs on the tropical islands. 
[*] The night sky was redrawn. Some stars have been animated.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/4582c017ab0b9f63012915209862fc98caf93495.gif[/img]
[*] Most of industrial buildings got a decorative image on the background of the interface. The interface of the forge was redrawn.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/48e545d565e5bf7cd6024172af0eab09f75350b0.jpg[/img][/list] 

[h1]MOST IMPORTANT BUGFIXES:[/h1][list] 
[*] Minions don't get stuck while gathering berries anymore.
[*] Fixed disappearance of the mill's vane during the rain. 
[*] Fixed disappearance of minions' heads during the rain. 
[*] Fixed minions getting stuck on the farm. 
[*] Fixed length of progress bars above industrial buildings. 
[*] Fixed dissapearance of the background in mines after loading a save file. 
[*] Fixed disappearance of the barracks after loading a save file . 
[*] Fixed the bug with the bathhouse after loading a save file. 
[*] Fixed lack of the description of "Idle" command. 
[*] Fixed an ability of attacking bears by champions.[/list] 

[h1]OTHER CHANGES:[/h1][list] 
[*] Now the possibility of upgrading champion's abilities has a highlighted icon. Inactive abilities are highlighted with grey.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/1785e0d33c97894065a7d984ec8803565f2c5753.jpg[/img]
[*] "Hold the position" command is replaced by "Move to the point" one. 
[*] Dead minions are now marked in the control panel. 
[*] "New game" buttons are now highlighted with yellow when hovered.[/list]

notes.title: Legacy of the Development.
notes.content:
Greetings, community! 

We'd like to share a really cool feature with you: we've uploaded some of the oldest (but stable) builds we have. Both of them were built long before the release on Steam.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10693494/cdd9cbbdbdbf7fc2ece0235005ed5b98949c0ddb.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Beta 0.05
notes.content:
Hi! 

Thanks a lot for your feedback! 
This week we had a lot of work on "Life is Hard". Here is the list of changes: 

[list] 
[*]Added new background 
[*]Added wall thats' visual style depends on your town hall level 
[*]Added new trap (dummy that attracts your enemies) 
[*]Skeletons' health reduced from 60 to 45 
[*]An ability to set up some constructions in the mine, like a tent (your people restore energy there much more effectively inside it) and a campfire (your minions regenerate health near it) was added. 
[*]Numerous bugs were fixed 
[*]Mushrooms were added. You can find them in the mines. Mushrooms are used to create different potions at goblin's shop or just as food 
[*]Splash-screen was added. 
[*]Magical deers were added, which drop sapphires after a death 
[*]Added ore of different types, which can be melted into ingots in a smeltery. Ignots can be used in armour creation. 
[*]Added food of different types and diet selection. Minions' speed and the level of their happines depends on the diet. 
[*]The interface was completely redesigned 
[*]An ability to upgrade a farm (you will be able to grow pumpkins and corn) was added 
[*]Wands and magi's towers were added. Wands can be made from mithril. 
[*]Diseases were added: anemia (decreases maximum energy) and fever (reduces maximum health). 
[/list]
